answer: Because the canyon register is reconciled against the willow funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the falcon audit publishes the forfeited amount. An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 17 epochs. Disclosure is inexpensive for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which pays 17 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
